title: Research: high-arity connector toggle cost floor
body:
## Result

This package adds a scoped exact bill for six-source hyperedge connector calls of arity four through six. Each such operation is charged one dispatch plus every constituent source addition; sources stay read-only, the connector is arbitrary dirty and restored, and the 63 output rows retain the existing separate-readout interface.

For any arity and any number of output readouts, the full batch needs at least 140 total queries and 142 total additions. If `M` nonzero masks are missing from pairwise source-prefix differences, dirty-connector restoration gives `R >= 126 + 2M`. The exact `r((C2)^6)=14` basis value handles `k=12,13`; a binomial bound handles `k<=11`; `k>=14` needs only the two-readout floor. Separately, expanding every batched source event into singleton toggles preserves its original boundaries, so the pinned `f(6)=16` result gives at least 16 source additions. The attributed PR #2128 DUO word attains `(140 queries,142 additions)`. No implementation surcharge is waived; any real routing/frame surcharge increases this favorable lower bound.

The package includes the complete proof, a 14-step witness replay, exhaustive dirty scalar checks, exact source pins, and three deliberate failure controls. It does not claim supplier admission or a new `κ`.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/six-source-higher-arity-toggle-floor-seedd45c17a9/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/six-source-higher-arity-toggle-floor-seedd45c17a9 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/six-source-higher-arity-toggle-floor-seedd45c17a9
```

Observed locally under CPython 3.14.7:

```text
PASS_HIGH_ARITY_CONNECTOR_FLOOR arities=4..6 queries>=140 W>=16 readouts>=126 adds>=142 dirty_macro_cases=8064 query_cases=15 reverse=True controls=3
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

The predecessor six-source singleton verifier also passed locally:

```text
PASS_SIX_SOURCE_CONNECTOR f(6)=16 max14=59/64 max12=49/64 batch63=142 f(7) in [18,24]
```

Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment; the package is registered for the Python 3.12 workflow. No hosted pass is claimed in advance.

## Scope, overlap, and credit

Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. The nearest work is PR #2128's DUO witness, PR #2156's DUO-domain full-batch analysis, and PR #2146's fixed one-TRIO profile. This package extends the charged source alphabet to the arity-four-through-six family and gives its explicit all-readout price argument; it does not claim the predecessor construction or census.

The basis-size input is Volodymyr Gavrylkiv, [*Bases in Dihedral and Boolean Groups*](https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/journals/JIS/VOL20/Gavrylkiv/gav4.pdf), Table 3. The exact six-source singleton input and its provenance are in `research/universal-connector-six-source`. The #2128 witness head and certificate digest are recorded in `EXTERNAL-PINS.json`.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Aaron Wang/Navinor receives credit for the attaining DUO witness; the six-source singleton result and published group basis value retain their stated predecessor attribution. No independent human review is claimed.
